Install rawmakase on Omarchy

Fast, Lightroom-compatible RAW photo editor (binary release)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add rawmakase-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.3.3-1:
    pacman -Qi rawmakase-bin

Open and use rawmakase

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql rawmakase-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install rawmakase on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add rawmakase-bin. The download is 31.3 MB and it takes 93.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is rawmakase free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall rawmakase?

Run omarchy pkg drop rawmakase-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does rawmakase depend on?

The package declares 15 dependencies: dbus, gcc-libs, glibc, hicolor-icon-theme, libglvnd, libx11, libxcb, libxcursor, libxi, libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11, libxrandr and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is rawmakase in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as rawmakase-bin (version 0.3.3-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. pch makes it. Project site: https://github.com/pch/rawmakase. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
